## PlaybackStats class

> This API is provided as a beta preview for developers and may change based on feedback that we receive. Do not use this API in a production environment.
> 

Collects playback metrics and reports them periodically.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare class PlaybackStats extends ContainerPlugin 
```
**Extends:** ContainerPlugin

## Remarks

While the playback is playing, a [PlaybackStatsReport](./player.playbackstatsreport.md) is emitted every `reportInterval` milliseconds with the container's `container:stats:report` event. A final report is emitted on pause, stop, end of the playback and when the container is destroyed. The current metrics can be read at any time with [PlaybackStats.getStats()](./player.playbackstats.getstats.md)<!-- -->.

Configuration options - [PlaybackStatsPluginSettings](./player.playbackstatspluginsettings.md)
